_readme: Fully fictional messages for demos, tests, and CI (§3.5, ADR 0006). Vendor sender domains are shaped like @carrier-example.com so this corpus is safe to show in a recording without implying a real vendor relationship. No name/policy/amount here overlaps with docs/SPEC.md's narrative examples — verified by test/no-real-names.spec.js.
